options.notes: User-submitted 720p VoD scan, Undertow Spillway RM private battle, KO win. The winning team's tag is the Greek small letter psi (ψ, U+03C8: x-height top with a descender, not the cap-height Ψ) before a star; the names atlas had no ψ, so it read as "4" (here), "y" or "T". Defeat-side names are left out: each has a tiny superscript between the dot and the name that isn't legible at 720p. Weapons are left out (kit variants not verifiable at this size).
